parede.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production game texture, opaque square seamless tile. Reference image defines foliage art style ONLY. Fill entire image edge to edge with a continuous dense vertical wall of small green leaves, moss and fine interwoven trailing creepers. Natural hand-painted storybook garden game rendering. Even detail and lighting, rich varied medium greens, small yellow-green leaves among deeper green shadows, consistent leaf scale. No large recognizable repeating shapes, no flowers, no ground, no soil, no roots, no rock, no sky, no grass blades, no platform, no borders, no perspective. Opposite edges tile seamlessly; uniform density and shading across tile, no vignette or gradient, no text. This tile will be rendered 300 world pixels wide, leaves must be small and varied like the vertical faces in reference.

aquatico.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production 2D game sprite sheet on a perfectly flat solid pure magenta #FF00FF background for technical chroma removal. No shadows on background, no gradient, no checkerboard. Reference image is style guide only, do NOT reproduce scene. Layout SIX isolated objects on 3 columns x 2 rows with broad empty magenta gutters and equal 512x512 cells. Top left: a natural vertical grey stone pillar section, broad solid rough stone with subtle moss, rectangular full-width stone mass filling its cell except 45px margins, same width from top to bottom, no cap or water. Top middle: one tiny orange freshwater fish in side view facing right, slender natural body, little tail and fins. Top right: one golden-yellow freshwater fish side view facing right. Bottom left: one muted blue freshwater fish facing right. Bottom middle: one small tuft of delicate green freshwater ribbon plants, rooted base and 5 slender upright leaves, no pot or stone. Bottom right: a low small clump of freshwater aquatic leaves and tiny pebbles at base. All objects centered within their own cells and separated. Painterly storybook garden style exactly like reference, compact natural detail, no heavy outlines, no labels or text, no scene, no water or background other than pure magenta. Fish roughly 250 pixels wide in source cells so usable downsampled to 20-28 game pixels.
